en: I've brought back the hat you dropped
in the street some time ago.
...My hat. My red hat.
Thank you...
I was so fond of it.
...We've only just met, and yet somehow
you feel so familiar to me...
But to find you lying in bed...
Are you feeling all right?
I'm sorry for letting you see me
in such an unseemly state...
But now that I've seen your face,
I think I feel a little better...
Really? I'm glad.
Take care of yourself.
I'll come again, Rose.
I'll come again.
Promise?
I'll be waiting,
Say,
They say my illness is a strange one
that even the doctor doesn't understand...
I get terrible dizzy spells and faint,
or moan all night with a raging fever,
or so I'm told.
Strangely, I don't remember any of it.
But whenever you come, somehow
I feel so much better.
I wonder why?
, you came!
Rose, you're able to get up now.
The doctor and Father tell me I
should still be in bed, but...
I'm fine now.
More importantly, there's a painting
I just had to show you today.
It's a portrait of my ancestor.
Isn't she beautiful?
Her name was Lady Rowena. She lived
a full 200 years ago...
(......This portrait!!)
Father found this portrait in the attic
just recently.
Portraits were all the rage back then,
and it seems Lady Rowena, too, had
a great many portraits painted.
But it seems this one had been
sleeping in the attic all this time.
This lady is said to have vanished
all of a sudden, but...
some say she really died of a strange illness.
There are all sorts of stories.
This place... is it the garden here?
Yes, it is.
It's the linden tree in our garden.
I'll show you sometime.
There's something written on the back.
"...Farewell...
I am leaving with my beloved
for his homeland...
October 1682, Rowena..."
Is this... a farewell note, I wonder?
Oh,
You came again today! I'm so glad.
This is the linden tree I told you about.
Isn't it lovely?
...Are you feeling better now?
I think I've gotten better,
but the doctor still looks grim...
It seems my examination results were poor.
...I'm scared.
I feel so well right now...
I don't want to die!
I don't want to be apart from you.
I want to live, and be with you always...
Rose...
Like Lady Rowena,
would you have the courage to leave home?
